placements.why: The document's content is fundamentally about instrument calibration — establishing and verifying a spectrograph against reference plates. No existing strata category covers this; Calibration is the organizational home this content calls for.
placements.title: Calibration established as a first-class organizational concern
placements.theme: Instrument calibration — establishing and verifying readiness against reference standards — constitutes its own organizational category for observational work.

placements.title: Spectrograph calibration confirmed across the full observing band
placements.theme: Instrument calibration must be established at the observing frequency and verified against reference plates across the full band before the instrument is trusted for observation.
placements.why: Both segments assert the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration at 88.4 MHz verified against June reference plates, holding across the full observing band. This is a thematic subject future envelopes will feed — calibration updates, re-verification, band extensions — not a one-time fact. No existing leaf holds this theme.
